facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports the Ministry of the Interior presented on 6 May 2026 one digital platform for managing civil registration and producing the new biometric national ID card, with civil records being digitised.
facts.system: digital platform for civil registration management and biometric national identity card

BDI.note: No number at birth is mentioned.
Operation and maintenance are not described.
The ID number is to serve for passports and administrative services; no public register keyed on it is stated in service or planned by name.

facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports Burundian authorities said they have nearly completed the infrastructure for the biometric national ID and await a decree to govern its use.
